tavern.description: The Tavern increases increases morale for troops defending the city.

fort.name: Fort
fort.description: The Fort provides your town with defensive walls.

citadel.name: Citadel
citadel.description: Including a 50% increase to base creature growth, the Citadel adds a keep, and other terrain obstacles, to a town's defenses.

castle.name: Castle
castle.description: The Castle adds two arrow towers, fortifies your town's defenses, and doubles base creature growth.

villageHall.name: Village Hall
villageHall.description: The Village Hall allows you to purchase town structures and earns your kingdom 500 gold per day.

cityHall.name: City Hall
cityHall.description: The City Hall allows you to purchase town structures and earns your kingdom 2000 gold per day.

capitol.name: Capitol
capitol.description: The Capitol earns your kingdom 4000 gold per day.

marketplace.name: Marketplace
marketplace.description: With the Marketplace, you can buy and sell resources (exchange rates increase with each Marketplace you own).

shipyard.description: The Shipyard allows you to purchase ships.

resourceSilo.description: The Resource Silo provides you with an additional +1 sulfur each day.

blacksmith.description: The Blacksmith provides your armies with Ballista.

special3.description: Casino allows you to spend 1000 gold once a week to draw a reward, including random resources, treasures, or no reward.

rewards.message:
{Casino}

After spending 1,000 gold to participate, the casino staff opened the box, and you didn't win any rewards. Please come back next time.

{Casino}

After spending 1,000 gold to participate, the casino staff opened the box, you have won some resources, congratulations!

{Casino}

After spending 1,000 gold to participate, the casino staff opened the box, you have won an artifact, congratulations!

{Casino}

After spending 1,000 gold to participate, the casino staff opened the box, you have won an artifact, and you get your money back. congratulations!

{Casino}

After spending 1,000 gold to participate, the casino staff opened the box, you become the focus of everyone...You won the jackpot, congratulations! Wish you good luck everyday!

configuration.onSelectMessage:
{Casino}

Casino allows you to spend 1000 gold once a week to draw a reward, including random resources, treasures, or no reward.
configuration.onVisitedMessage:
{Casino}

You hear the shouts of gamblers in the casino, and they invite you to come and try your luck, but you still think that you should not waste your time on boring gambling.
configuration.onEmptyMessage:
{Casino}

You hear the shouts of gamblers in the casino, and they invite you to come and try your luck, but you cannot afford the gambling money. You convince yourself that you should not waste your time on boring gambling.
